fixed_defects.summary: Disabled legacy aliases could survive local-storage reload and calculate from their own obsolete profile.
fixed_defects.resolution: Redirected to the canonical concrete product key before the ration becomes available.

fixed_defects.summary: A hidden or disabled product key could still be added programmatically.
fixed_defects.resolution: State.add and composite child add/replace now apply the same redirect/block contract.

fixed_defects.summary: Three unsupported profiles had no safe canonical replacement and could remain in old saved rations.
fixed_defects.resolution: They are removed from the active ration before HEI or nutrient calculation and recorded in the migration report.

fixed_defects.summary: A family with one selectable manual-confirmation profile could render a disabled Add button without a reachable confirmation action.
fixed_defects.resolution: The confirmation control is now shown for single-profile families and remains mandatory after changing to any manual profile.

fixed_defects.summary: Four active canonical profiles remained marked as hidden aliases by an older duplicate-resolution layer, while the family registry already treated them as the canonical selectable variants.
fixed_defects.resolution: The four canonical profiles are restored to ordinary search and the three stale legacy alias records are reconciled to point to the canonical keys; numeric nutrient and HEI fields remain unchanged.
